answer.summary: Spring ApplicationContext fails to start in every API test class (CredentialApiTest, MarkingDefinitionApiTest, NotificationHttpIsolationTest and others), so the 'flaky' history is misleading. The root cause is a deterministic bean circular reference (workflowService -> workflowEndService -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService). Re-running the same commit will hit the same cycle. The PR only lists a test file as changed, so the cycle may predate it, but it is still a blocker for this PR.

evidence.quote: Relying upon circular references is discouraged and they are prohibited by default. Update your application to remove the dependency cycle between beans. As a last resort, it may be possible to break the cycle automatically by setting spring.main.allow-circular-references to true.
